verdict.rationale: Kling documents a RESTful API with JWT AccessKey/SecretKey authentication, global and China endpoints, and per-call pricing for text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Together these establish a first-party API for submitting video generation jobs. Nothing in the evidence describes how to check job status or retrieve the finished video. Missing for 10: documented task submission/polling or callback flow, documented retrieval of the output asset (URL/download), API reference depth, independent hands-on corroboration.
